inspiration.title: The "Solo Leveling" Mindset
inspiration.content:
The name is a nod to the manga Solo Leveling. However, "Solo Developing" doesn't mean working alone; it’s a commitment to constant progression. Like an infinite "level up," I treat every project as an opportunity to master every facet of a product—from technical architecture to marketing and business strategy.

Success requires more than just code; it depends on understanding the market and collaborating effectively with internal teams. This holistic approach allows me to bridge communication gaps and maintain a high-level vision. I combine the efficiency of an autonomous builder with the collaborative spirit needed to bring our shared vision to life, friction-free.

profile.title: Who Am I?
profile.name: Fabien Chung
profile.bio:
With over 20 years of experience in the tech industry, my core expertise lies in mobile-first full-stack development. However, my journey extends beyond code. Through my professional experience, I have honed Product Ownership skills to better align technology with business needs, while integrating AI automations to maximize efficiency.

Currently, I am expanding my marketing knowledge to build the most complete skillset possible. My goal is to offer a holistic vision that bridges the gap between robust engineering and product growth.

Today I publish my own apps through my company, Applications Ben Cool, build apps for clients — sometimes as a shareholder, as with Namewish — and volunteer on the mobile app of LocoMotion, a Québec non-profit for neighbourhood vehicle sharing.

privacyPage.seoDescription: What personal information solodeveloping.com collects (Google Analytics statistics, server logs, language preference, emails you send), why, and how to exercise your rights.
privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.intro: This policy explains what personal information solodeveloping.com collects, why, who receives it and what you can do about it. The site has no accounts, no forms and no advertising.

sections.title: Who is responsible
paragraphs: solodeveloping.com is run by Fabien Chung (Solo Developing), Montréal, Quebec, Canada. Fabien Chung is the person in charge of the protection of personal information and can be reached at hello@solodeveloping.com.

sections.title: Audience statistics (Google Analytics)
paragraphs: The site uses Google Analytics 4 to count visits and see which pages are read. Google Analytics sets first-party cookies (_ga and _ga_<ID>, kept for up to 2 years) and receives the page address, the referring page, your browser and device type, an approximate location derived from your IP address, and events such as scrolling or clicks. Google Analytics 4 does not log or store IP addresses.

The data is processed by Google LLC and may be stored outside Canada. The statistics are used only to improve the site. You can block these cookies in your browser settings or with the Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on.

sections.title: Fonts
paragraphs: Typefaces are loaded from Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), so your browser sends your IP address and browser details to Google when a page loads. Google Fonts does not set cookies.

sections.title: Hosting and server logs
paragraphs: The site is hosted by Hostinger. Its servers and content delivery network record technical request data (IP address, date and time, requested address, browser user agent and referring page) to deliver pages and protect the service. These logs are kept by Hostinger under its own retention policy.

sections.title: Preferences stored in your browser
paragraphs: The site remembers your language in your browser’s local storage (i18nextLng) and in a cookie named i18next that expires after 7 days. While you browse, session storage keeps the service page you came from (sd:origin-facet) so the menu can link back to it. These values stay in your browser and are not used for tracking.

sections.title: Email
paragraphs: If you write to hello@solodeveloping.com, your name, email address and message are used only to answer you and follow up on your request. They are not sold, shared for marketing or added to a mailing list.

sections.title: Links to other sites
paragraphs: Links to LinkedIn, GitHub, pub.dev, Medium, app stores and client projects open services that have their own privacy policies.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under Quebec’s Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector and Canada’s PIPEDA, you can ask to access, correct or delete the personal information held about you, or withdraw your consent. Send your request to hello@solodeveloping.com; it is answered within 30 days. You can also file a complaint with the Commission d’accès à l’information du Québec.

items.term: Commission d’accès à l’information du Québec

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: When this policy changes, the date at the top of the page is updated.

paragraphs: A static, read-only JSON API with Fabien Chung’s profile, services, products and articles, in English and French. The base URL is https://solodeveloping.com/api/. Responses are UTF-8 JSON and can be fetched from any origin (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *).

sections.title: OpenAPI description
paragraphs: The API is described by an OpenAPI 3.1 document, in JSON and in YAML. It is also listed in the RFC 9727 API catalog, which every page advertises in a Link header (rel="api-catalog").

items.description: OpenAPI 3.1, JSON (also at /api/openapi.json)
OpenAPI 3.1, YAML (also at /api/openapi.yaml)
API catalog (application/linkset+json)

sections.title: Errors
paragraphs: Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with a machine-readable code and a hint on how to fix the request. Unknown API paths answer 404 with the code not_found; methods other than GET, HEAD and OPTIONS answer 405 with the code method_not_allowed. Anywhere else on the site, a request sent with Accept: application/json also gets its 404 as JSON.

sections.title: Authentication and limits
paragraphs: There is no authentication: the API only serves public data. Responses are static files delivered through a CDN and there are no published rate limits; please cache what you fetch. The current version is 1.0.0, given in info.version of the OpenAPI document.

sections.title: Pages as Markdown
paragraphs: Request any page with Accept: text/markdown, or add .md to its address (index.html.md for / and /fr/), to get a clean Markdown version without navigation or scripts. Unknown pages answer 404 with a Markdown body.
